text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No, um... there just aren't many clouds today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer...
Can we continue our meeting tonight...?

No sooner had she spoken than Silence Suzuka dashed outside
without waiting for an answer.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
As I ran while gazing at the sky,
the sun began to set—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The bright sun turned into a crimson sunset.
Before I knew it, the moon and stars were in sight...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It felt…… so very good.
Fufufu.

Alongside a satisfied Silence Suzuka,
we resumed our meeting.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"The moment I started running, the sky suddenly clouded over.
The sun completely disappeared, too..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It was so beautiful at first...
Maybe I should have gone outside a bit sooner.

Seeing how down Silence Suzuka was,
I told her we could continue the rest of our meeting tomorrow.
